scope.description: Whole flac application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Lossless audio encode/decode, sample formats/channels, compression choices, metadata, seeking and integrity testing.

coverage.rationale: The central lossless round trip is covered, but sample formats, channels, encoder controls and metadata operations are substantially restricted.

scope.description: PCM16 mono/stereo WAV lossless archive and canonical decode, optionally retaining three declared labels.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Archive/decode intent and canonical downstream audio hide flags and integrity plumbing; the workflow remains a relatively direct encoding task.

limitations: PCM16 native FLAC only; no Ogg, 24-bit, general tagging, pictures or seek-table control; consistency does not establish recording authenticity.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
